name: Endless Runner
author: Richard McCormack
description: A minimalist endless runner: keep going and avoid the obstacles for as long as you can to push your score up.

descriptions.en: A minimalist endless runner: keep going and avoid the obstacles for as long as you can to push your score up.
descriptions.it: Un endless runner minimalista: vai avanti evitando gli ostacoli il più a lungo possibile per far salire il punteggio.
